caption:
MillD took India's protein gap straight to the streets with a new campaign about everyday food. Now even your daily roti has a performance review.

Would you stop to read about protein on your way to work, or just scroll past? Let me know below! 👇

Source: IMPACT Magazine

#MillD #MarketingNews #Advertising #BrandCampaign #IndianBrands

post.news: MillD launched an outdoor campaign asking if better protein habits can power India, focusing on everyday protein and the protein gap.
post.take: We are now guilt-tripping people through their rotis. Peak marketing behavior.
post.insight: Brands are turning everyday food habits into outdoor thought pieces. If your lunch can solve a country's protein gap, you are basically doing public service.
